id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ca8: "Hm, if not shelter, you want the lord, Sir Diego? Then I'm afraid you're out of luck.

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cc8: "I see. I narrowly escaped from Heliodor myself. This town hasn't been destroyed yet and is safe.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd6: "What are my scattered countrymen doing now? I hope they're safe.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ce6: "W-who are these people...! Is the world finally over...!

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d04: "Hey, help me. That parade person, if I let my guard down, he tries to teach me to dance~.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d26: "Damn it, I can't take this. Lost at the casino again... My money just keeps shrinking.

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d41: "The world is over... Everyone will die... The Dark One will rule the world...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d58: "Ugh... my head hurts. This person made me drink too much last night. I'm too queasy to stand.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d67: "The world might end, but then I'll enjoy it to the last! Otherwise life's a loss! Hahaha!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d75: "The world is at peace! No more fear of the Dark One! The booze is the best ever! Hahahaha!

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d96: "Since the parade people came, I feel a little better. Maybe laughing helped fight off the illness.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2db9: "Just between us, I'm already healed. The caregiver's cute, so I'm pretending to suffer.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dc4: "Her troubled face is the best. This might be lovesickness. Mm... mmm... it hurts.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dd5: "That big building over there is Daddy's manor. I need to steel myself, so {var:1}, go on to Daddy's.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2df3: "The sisters went deeper into the village to ask around. I'm minding things here!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dff: "...If you need to go out again, we'll go with you, our parade boss!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e0d: "Oh, Boss! You're finally leaving! I've kept this palanquin toasty warm, so we're all set!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e18: "When you're ready, head south of the village! Don't worry, we'll follow right behind you, Boss!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e2a: "Chelon doesn't want to see her father until she gets her pendant back. Let's beat Furfur quickly for her!

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e47: "Yoo-hoo! The kidnapped folks are back and the villagers are so happy! Come on, Boss, dance and sing!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e56: "...Huh? Have you seen the sister? She hasn't come here, so she must be somewhere in town!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e64: "We've arrived at the sister's hometown! Cheer up, Boss, let's go!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e6f: "You're finally off to the manor. We'll wait here! I don't know why, but good luck!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e7c: "This room is big enough to dance in! We can cheer up Daddy with a dance! I'll do my best for the sister!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e8c: "Oh, Boss! As you know, this is our sister's hometown, Puerto Valor!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e95: "We're giving it our all to bring smiles back to this town! Please, take your time.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ea8: "Oh, Boss, it's been ages! Welcome to Puerto Valor!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ead: "When we saw Yggdrasil revive in the sky, the whole town cheered, sure you'd beaten the Dark One!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eb9: "Oh, since you're here, do see our sister's father, Boss! He'll welcome you gladly!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ec8: "Oh, Boss. Leaving already? We had so much to catch up on. What a shame~.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ed0: "...You're always warmly welcome, Boss. If you're nearby, do stop by this town!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eed: "The villagers seem afraid of something. This gloomy air hides a complicated story.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2efc: "Huh? The sister probably went deeper into the village to see Bahatra home.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f0c: "They feared Furfur would keep taking from them, hurting them bit by bit.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f19: "But crossing the World-Saving Parade is their undoing. We'll surely teach them a lesson! Hee hee.
